notes: «قال وسمعت أخاه أبا بكر» opens a second isnad for the same story (the verse about the garden), so it is a second group; «أخاه» is a relation to the previous man and the name stands alone.
The first route ends at Ibn Abbas, who relates the story; the second ends at Umar, whose words are quoted.
The gloss in the report is not present; the Prophet is not in this chain.
